name: Krrish (Krishna Mehra)
title: India's Superhero & Astral Guardian

attacks.name: Superhuman Telekinetic Meteor Punch
attacks.description: Leaps hundreds of feet into the sky and crashes down with superhuman velocity and a celestial astral punch shattering DOM containers.

attacks.name: Jadoo Astral Lotus Shockwave
attacks.description: Unleashes the sacred cosmic lotus energy frequency gifted by Jadoo, projecting expanding cyan astral shockwaves.

attacks.name: Cosmic Telekinetic Barrier Deflection
attacks.description: Projects an impenetrable astral telekinesis field, reflecting projectiles and repelling surrounding web elements.

attacks.name: Acrobatic Skyscraper Vault & Slice
attacks.description: Performs gravity-defying superhuman parkour flips through midair, cleaving headers and content cards with sheer momentum.

voicelines: Jadoo ki shakti aur himmat se, main Krrish hoon!
No power can defeat the courage to protect!
The mask is just a symbol — the real power is inside!
You cannot outrun the leap of Krrish!
